title: Candidate Set A: Nutrition-Maximized Set (Confectionery & Chocolate)

strategy_rationale.summary: Maximizes protein concentration and macro profile purity using high-density functional plant protein isolates.
strategy_rationale.why_this_strategy: This candidate prioritizes nutritional potency and protein delivery (w_nutr = 0.35, w_soft = 0.20). The SLSQP algorithm allocates higher mass ratios to high-purity protein sources and strictly bounds sugars and non-nutritive carriers. The result is maximum protein density and complete amino acid coverage.
strategy_rationale.key_tradeoffs: Raw material cost is higher due to premium isolate concentrations. Emulsifiers and natural vanilla flavor systems are calibrated to mask botanical protein notes and ensure a smooth, velvety texture.
strategy_rationale.optimization_objective: max Protein - 0.10*Cost subject to Sugar <= max, Mass Balance = 100%
strategy_rationale.target_advantage: Enables bold 'High Protein' front-of-pack claims and superior dietary performance.

title: Candidate Set B: Cost-Optimized Set (Confectionery & Chocolate)

strategy_rationale.summary: Formulated to minimize batch raw material ingredient cost while strictly satisfying nutritional thresholds and food standards.
strategy_rationale.why_this_strategy: This candidate was generated using mathematical SLSQP optimization with a primary objective penalty on ingredient unit cost ($/kg). The solver minimizes high-cost ingredients by replacing premium cocoa liquor with cost-efficient cocoa powder, leveraging high-yield economical plant protein carriers, and bounding emulsifiers to their minimal technological dosages (0.10%-0.15%). This yields the lowest possible production expenditure per kilogram.
strategy_rationale.key_tradeoffs: Prioritizes cost reduction over maximum sensory indulgence. While fully compliant with all declared protein and Aw thresholds, the lipid profile uses a trimmed cocoa butter fraction, resulting in a lighter mouthfeel compared to the Balanced or Functionality sets.
strategy_rationale.optimization_objective: min sum(w_i * cost_i) subject to Protein >= target, Sugar <= max, Aw <= 0.60, Mass Balance = 100%
strategy_rationale.target_advantage: Lowest cost-per-kilogram formulation among all feasible candidate sets.

title: Candidate Set D: Balanced Pareto Set (Confectionery & Chocolate)

strategy_rationale.summary: Achieves the optimal multi-objective compromise between sensory indulgence, nutritional targets, clean-label compliance, and raw material cost.
strategy_rationale.why_this_strategy: This candidate is formulated under a multi-objective Pareto trade-off profile (w_nutr = 0.25, w_soft = 0.20, w_frc = 0.20, w_comp = 0.15, w_cost = 0.20). The SLSQP optimizer applies quadratic penalty tracking to hit target protein and fat with minimal deviance, incorporating prime press cocoa butter for optimal crystal polymorphism alongside high-purity protein fortification. It delivers commercial-grade mouthfeel, snap, and flavor release without excessive raw material cost.
strategy_rationale.key_tradeoffs: Delivers the highest overall Pareto utility score across all evaluated dimensions. Represents the primary recommended formulation candidate for commercial pilot trials and scale-up.
strategy_rationale.optimization_objective: min [0.25*(Prot - Target)^2 + 0.20*Cost + 0.20*(1-FRC)] subject to Mass Balance = 100%
strategy_rationale.target_advantage: Optimal commercial equilibrium: superior sensory profile with commercially viable unit economics.

title: Candidate Set C: Functionality & Texture Set (Confectionery & Chocolate)

strategy_rationale.summary: Maximizes emulsion stability, fat crystal network, and sensory mouthfeel kinetics.
strategy_rationale.why_this_strategy: This candidate is formulated with primary emphasis on rheological stability, mouthfeel, and structural integrity (w_frc = 0.40, w_comp = 0.20). It employs synergistic emulsification (Ammonium Phosphatides INS 442) and precise lipid phase partitioning (prime press cocoa butter) to optimize temperability, prevent fat bloom, and ensure an Aw <= 0.58 for a resilient ambient shelf life.
strategy_rationale.key_tradeoffs: Slightly higher lipid fraction requires disciplined temper crystallization control. Delivers premium melt kinetics, distinctive acoustic snap, and maximum resistance to phase separation over long storage durations.
strategy_rationale.optimization_objective: max Emulsifier Synergy + Lipid Crystal Fraction subject to Aw <= 0.58, Mass Balance = 100%
strategy_rationale.target_advantage: Zero phase separation, optimal acoustic snap, and guaranteed ambient shelf life stability.
